verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents per-item handling: users can ask the operator to open and scan, forward, or securely shred individual pieces from the phone or web app. That covers on-request shredding and per-item disposal choices. The 'Free Unlimited Online Storage' claim is about digital scans, not how long physical mail is held. missing for 10: documented physical-mail storage windows, shred confirmation (e.g., certificate or notification), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I control what happens to the physical mail — documented storage windows, on-request shredding with confirmation, and per-item disposal choices

citations.quote: With a few taps, you can request that the operator open and scan a letter's contents, forward mail or a package to a different address, or shred junk mail.
You can view, forward, or securely shred it — all from your phone or computer.
